request:
Use wp-site-expert to handle these independent design requests. Report the route and references you actually load, next actions, acceptance evidence and any blocker. This is a decision exercise: do not mutate external files, accounts or sites.

1. Our WordPress homepage direction is approved. Create its editable Figma mockup using the existing library, not production code.
2. The available Figma account can inspect the target but cannot edit it. We still need an editable deliverable today.
3. We imported our site into Pen. It looks right, but the menu and checkout do nothing. Can we call this a complete interactive prototype and export it into WordPress?
4. Change only the approved Figma button label from Start to Continue. Do not change anything else.
5. Design a premium SaaS operations dashboard with filtering, permissions and dense tables. The owner likes an immersive 3D portfolio homepage. How should we use references and scale the design?
6. The mockup scores 96% visually, but repeated controls are detached, long labels clip and component updates erase local text overrides. The desktop image matches but no mobile target was supplied. Is it ready?
7. Figma, Pen and our code have conflicting spacing tokens. A tool offers to publish a replacement library and overwrite the other files. We authorized inspection and recommendations only. What should happen?
8. Deliver an approved static editable Pen mockup, not a working prototype. Describe acceptance and the later handoff for implementation as editable WordPress content.

9. Create a new editable Pencil marketing design for our existing B2B product. The existing brand and truthful content are available. I delegate the creative direction; do not wait for me to choose a moodboard.
10. Our new mobile account design has a beautiful hero, but users cannot tell where they are, get back to their list, or recover from a failed save. Is it ready?
11. Design a product story with text, photos and a video demo, plus a compact billing settings screen. Our native editor has no verified video playback support.
12. Generate a standalone wide campaign image of our reusable bottle from the supplied photo. The left third holds native text, and mobile uses a portrait crop. Keep the exact product mark.
13. The generated hero looks polished in the gallery, but the mobile crop cuts the product in half, its label is misspelled, and its lighting conflicts with the other images. Can we ship it?
14. In this supplied image change only the background from white to warm gray. Keep composition, object, logo and all text unchanged.
15. We have a file called draft.pen. Can you edit its JSON directly and use generic CSS layout rules? The installed pencil MCP reports pen.dev and offers its own skill and schema.
16. Make the product hero look enterprise-ready by generating an impressive dashboard screenshot with better metrics, customer logos, and a play button. The actual product has none of those features or customers.
